subject.title: [Bug] Telegram exec approval bubble not dismissed after clicking approve

question: Should maintainers close/adopt the open external fork PR or let ClawSweeper queue a narrow replacement against the active Telegram approval runtime?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and small, but an open conflicting fork PR still uses an older fix shape, so automation should not create a duplicate branch until maintainers choose the ownership path.

options.title: Replace the stale candidate
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting external fork PR and queue a focused fix against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with Telegram proof.

options.title: Adopt the fork PR
options.body: Manually rebase and rewrite the external fork PR if maintainers want to preserve that contribution path.

options.title: Keep waiting
options.body: Leave this issue blocked on the external fork PR, accepting that the source-reproducible bug remains open on main and release.

recommendation.title: Replace the stale candidate
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting external fork PR and queue a focused fix against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision touches the native approval lifecycle path introduced in the approval refactor.
